title: strict_spawn_class frees temp-allocator slices via context.allocator — 134 tracker bad-free reports per odin test run
evidence:
core/growth_test.odin:527-528:
	parent := make([]i32, n, context.temp_allocator)
	defer delete(parent)
core/growth_test.odin:556-557:
	size := make([]i32, n, context.temp_allocator)
	defer delete(size)

Empirical: `odin test core` prints 134 reports, e.g.
+++ bad free        @ 0x5AB000370 [growth_test.odin:528:strict_spawn_class()]
+++ bad free        @ 0x5AB000340 [growth_test.odin:557:strict_spawn_class()]
detail: make() uses context.temp_allocator but delete() defaults to context.allocator; Odin's test runner sets only context.allocator per task, so every one of 67 calls cross-frees (2 each). Tests pass, but fail-on-bad-memory mode would go red and the noise masks real bad frees.
recommended_fix: Match allocators: either `parent := make([]i32, n)` (delete default) or `defer delete(parent, context.temp_allocator)`; same for `size` at line 557.

title: Seed-floor diameter check uses w²+h², not the tile-extent diagonal — seed 49 on 40×30 loads but is unsatisfiable
detail: Positions are bounded to [0,39]×[0,29], so max candidate-terminal distance² is 39²+29²=2362. Seed 49 loads yet can never clear growth_seed_sep_ok — the exact silent permanent growth stall the check's comment claims to prevent.
recommended_fix: Compare seed² against (map_w_tiles−1)²+(map_h_tiles−1)² (the true max in-grid distance²), rejecting the whole unsatisfiable band, and update the comment/test rows.
